descriptions.text: Valtay Corporation Neural Enhancer #275. Variant 35.j This item is compatible with your Morphology and Interface. Warning: This pill will cause a permanent change to your brain. This item cannot be unequipped or undone once installed. Warning: You do not have a Valtay Corporation Neural Interface installed. While your current wetware system is compatible with this Neural Enhancer, it is recommended you visit a Valtay Corporate Outreach Center to discuss upgrade options. Payment and Legacy plans available. Keeping the Best of You alive. Current wetware: Syndicate Crawl Version 47.002b.Human. Taking this pill will install the following upgrade to your interface: Current elevation and airspeed.

beats.headline: Thanks, brain worm dudes
beats.text: The bronze Valtay box whirls open with great fanfare on another pill, identical to the last. This one installs a single upgrade: current elevation and airspeed. That's it? Carl thinks, and does not dare say it, then remembers how damn useful the last upgrade was. He pops it and thanks the brain worm dudes. The settings are a mess of velocities until he finds Relative Surface Speed, and the elevation display fills his screen with numbers until he picks kilometres and meters. Trying Planetary Sea-level Only is a mistake.

beats.headline: Eyes on the indicators
beats.text: In the gnomes' balloon basket Carl keeps his eye on the altitude indicator: almost three hundred meters, close to a thousand feet up, the escorts well below. When the three of them leap from the basket and the world to the north explodes, he tumbles with no point of reference, ignores the spinning world outside and fixes on the altitude and speed indicators in his vision. Donut cannot remember when to drink her potion. Now, he tells her. The potion is Dolores Doesn't Splat, and it only works if they are falling faster than two hundred kilometres an hour when they drink it.
